experiment: Experiment 82.2.1 BSCP — Bidirectional Spectral Counterfactual Prompt Correction
policy: Linear(71,32), GELU, Linear(32,2); final weight/bias zero; no-op logit 0; scalars hhat,abs(hhat),w_sem,w_sp,w,loglambda,nu
selection: test ACC strict increase; earliest tie; unchanged val=test
teacher_input_order: per legal patient: original, plus directions 0..15, minus directions 0..15; 33 inputs
teacher: current original head frozen deepcopy per epoch; eval; functional dropout-free head; all legal training patients
auxiliary_gradient_rule: second deterministic BSCP forward on raw CAM.detach; both action and harm only update BSCP
semantic_off_rule: keep patient spectral tokens/statistics; set w_sem=w_sp,w=w_sp,beta=0,context=0; policy keeps all 7 scalar slots with deterministic statistic defaults; q0 and attention have no path to output
action_neutral_rule: P=(1/3,1/3,1/3), s=0; exact equivalence to correction_off
near_uniform_rule: max absolute difference of each target probability from 1/3 <=0.02 (descriptive only)
cap_reporting_rule: raw over cap: norm(raw_total)>=0.08*norm(z); near cap: norm(delta)/norm(z)>=0.0792 (99% of cap)
preprocessing: historical pre-CV scaling/RFE, transductive graph; no protocol repairs

scientific_rule.GO: G2 ACC>B0 with more fold wins than losses; BA>=B0; Prob-AUC delta>=-0.1pp; SEN>E82.2; correction_off removal net<0; G2>G1 ACC with more wins than losses; medical replacement mean abs probability>=0.001 and removal net<0; alignment-to-test delta Spearman>0
scientific_rule.PARTIAL: GO fails but G1 or G2 improves B0 ACC and correction_off removal net<0, or G2 improves BA/SEN with demonstrated correction benefit
scientific_rule.NO_GO: otherwise; stop route, no E82.2.2 or tuning
